steps.stdout:
Edgee CLI

Usage: edgee [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  alias       Install shell aliases for Edgee launch commands
  auth        Authenticate with Edgee
  launch      Launch an AI tool routed through Edgee
  plugins     Show and install the plugins your organization has assigned to you
  settings    Configure compression settings for a coding-agent key
  stats       Show stored session stats [aliases: report]
  statusline  Render the Edgee statusline and manage the Copilot CLI integration
  reset       Reset Edgee credentials and connection mode
  update      Update Edgee [aliases: self-update]
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -p, --profile <PROFILE>  Profile to use [env: EDGEE_PROFILE=]
  -h, --help               Print help
  -V, --version            Print version
